items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: one fella used to play with, uh, Manuel Perez's George Field for a while.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Let's see now who's that trombone. I know him in the crown skin. See how the colors, and, uh, I can't tell you, but I knew him. I knew that name. If I could've just, I got books in there that got that, but I don't.
There was, uh, one fella used to play with, uh, Manuel Perez's George Field for a while. No, but I don't remember him.

Did Buddy Johnson ever work with him? They had a brown skin fella they called, uh, used to play with him then. Um, Ducey. Ducey. Ducey. Frankie Ducey. Frankie Ducey. Frankie Ducey. Oh, Frankie Ducey. Yeah, Frankie Ducey. He was playing with them too. Did you ever hear Dutre? Nori Dutre they called him.
